# Joshua J. Nduwamungu

> Joshua J. Nduwamungu is a Technical Program Manager at Google in the San Francisco Bay Area. He leads the technical work behind mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures across Google and Alphabet. Before Google, he co-authored three papers and one conference abstract on machine learning, Raman spectroscopy, and plant-based food at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln. Also known as Joshua John Nduwamungu, Joshua Nduwamungu, and Joshua J.N.

## Work

- [Career highlights](https://joshijo77.github.io/#work): Technical Program Manager at Google, since August 2022. Leads migration pipelines, workstation moves for acquired teams, and legacy cloud cleanup.
- [Career timeline](https://joshijo77.github.io/#journey): Google, Correlation One, CompuCom, Digital Leader Academy, LEAPR Labs, Snack It, and University of Nebraska-Lincoln.

## Projects

- [Machine learning for edible oil testing](https://joshijo77.github.io/research/edible-oil-machine-learning/): Raman spectroscopy plus nine machine learning models identified oil type with 96.7% accuracy. Food Chemistry, 2022. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.foodchem.2021.131471
- [Faster checks for oil type, adulteration, and oxidation](https://joshijo77.github.io/research/raman-spectroscopy-inform/): A magazine article for AOCS readers on using machine learning to read the Raman spectra of edible oils. INFORM, 2020. DOI: https://doi.org/10.21748/inform.04.2020.12
- [Egg white proteins for gluten-free veggie sausage](https://joshijo77.github.io/research/egg-white-veggie-sausage/): One egg white protein, M200, gave the texture closest to a commercial meat sausage. Food Bioengineering, 2022. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/fbe2.12028
